summary: A pallet position on the C-17A's cargo floor or ramp: one loaded pallet or airdrop bundle, released aft over the ramp

stations.name: cargo bay 1 left
stations.note: its place from hangar's design of the aircraft (the hold's floor and length as drawn; a load's CG half a load's height above the floor), its limit the pallet position's: engineering assumptions, no source giving either. The load leaves aft, over the ramp - drawn or rolling out at its extraction_ms, dropping off the sill at its ejection_ms
